policy.generationConditioningCaveat: existing generations use target-onset destination and cursor conditioning; timing is a retrospective latency projection and destination routing remains deferred
policy.humanFinish: final mutation-capable input in the closed target episode
policy.humanStart: latest material canonical READ or prior closed WRITE in the same continuous session
policy.humanTimeInterpretation: wall-clock estimate from the last observable material action; long gaps can include unobserved inactivity and remain visible rather than being silently capped
policy.nonMaterialActivity: focus, pointer movement, application routing, duplicate or suppressed OCR, and target expression do not move humanStartAt
policy.readHumanBoundary: raw lastActivityAt for the canonical READ
policy.realTimeScoring: semantic pass whose generation plus review and acceptance beats humanFinishedAt by the minimum savings
policy.semanticScoring: independent manual judgment of prediction content; never gated by timing
policy.workflowCompletion: non-mutating Return/submission after final content mutation, retained only as a diagnostic
policy.writeAvailableAt: retained diagnostic only; never the human-completion endpoint
policy.writeHumanBoundary: final contributing mutation, extended through confirmed submission when the episode closed by submission
